# System variables inside procedures
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/system-variables
#
# Each script creates the dataset unverified_procedures and procedures of its own. The dataset
# stays in the project after the scripts run. The emulator reads @@dataset_id and @@project_id in
# procedures, and rejects reads of other system variables there until these settle.

# Whether a procedure reads the @@dataset_project_id that its caller sets.

SET @@dataset_project_id = @@project_id;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.read_dataset_project() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN SELECT @@dataset_project_id = @@project_id; END;
CALL unverified_procedures.read_dataset_project()
?>

# What a procedure reads of @@time_zone.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.read_time_zone() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN SELECT @@time_zone; END;
CALL unverified_procedures.read_time_zone()
?>

# What an exception handler in a procedure reads of @@error.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.read_error() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN BEGIN SELECT ERROR('fail'); EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN SELECT @@error.message; END; END;
CALL unverified_procedures.read_error()
?>

# Whether dynamic SQL in a procedure resolves table names against the caller's @@dataset_id. The
# emulator resolves them as the procedure's own statements, which BigQuery does not resolve
# against it.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_procedures.t AS SELECT 1 AS n;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.dynamic_tables() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT n FROM t'; END;
SET @@dataset_id = 'unverified_procedures';
CALL unverified_procedures.dynamic_tables()
?>
